title: Whether untrained networks beat trained ones at V1 depends on a normalisation convention: evidence from two fMRI datasets
abstract: arXiv:2611.15533v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Untrained convolutional networks have been reported to rival or beat trained networks as models of primary visual cortex (V1), and we had reported such an advantage in THINGS fMRI. Under a pre-specified ridge readout, the trained network was ahead at every pooling grid in THINGS and in NSD (8 of 8 subjects), also when voxel responses were centred within runs. Representational similarity analysis (RSA) in THINGS depended on analysis choices (28 analyses: intervals above 0 in 5, below 0 in 9, including 0 in 14); in NSD with its standard normalisation, none of 28 analyses favoured the untrained network. The untrained advantage appears when a response profile common to all trials is left in the voxel patterns and model units are not centred, under correlation distance: removing the session-mean profile in THINGS reduced it from +0.030 to +0.005; with raw betas it reached +0.100 in THINGS, appeared in the THINGS test images, and app

translated_title: 未训练网络在V1建模上是否优于训练网络取决于归一化约定：来自两个fMRI数据集的证据
translated_abstract: 有报道称，未训练的卷积网络作为初级视觉皮层（V1）的模型可以媲美甚至超越训练过的网络，我们也曾在THINGS fMRI数据中报告过这种优势。然而，在预先设定的岭回归读出方案下，训练过的网络在THINGS和NSD的每一个汇聚网格上都领先（NSD全部8名受试者均是如此），即使体素响应在扫描内进行了中心化处理，结果依然如此。THINGS中的表征相似性分析（RSA）结果依赖于分析选择（28项分析中：5项区间高于0，9项低于0，14项包含0）；而在采用标准归一化的NSD中，28项分析没有一项支持未训练网络。未训练网络的优势只在以下条件下出现：当体素模式中保留所有试次共有的响应轮廓、模型单元未做中心化、并使用相关距离时——在THINGS中去除会话平均轮廓后，该优势从+0.030降至+0.005；而使用原始beta值时，该优势在THINGS中达到+0.100，并出现在THINGS测试图像中……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 通过对THINGS和NSD两个fMRI数据集的系统分析，本研究表明未训练卷积网络在V1建模上的所谓优势并非本质性的，而是由归一化约定和是否去除共有响应轮廓等分析选择所驱动——在预设定的岭回归读出和标准归一化下，训练网络始终表现更优。
en_tdlr: Using two fMRI datasets (THINGS and NSD), this study shows that the apparent advantage of untrained networks over trained ones as models of V1 depends on normalization conventions—under a pre-specified ridge readout and standard normalization, trained networks consistently outperform untrained ones.
